title: Dyson's cross-country drive with Feynman

tellings.quote: driving from Cleveland to Albuquerque and he offered to take me for a ride just to see the country

plain: The scientist Freeman Dyson recalled that in the late 1940s a colleague, Richard Feynman, was driving from Cleveland to Albuquerque, New Mexico. According to Dyson, Feynman offered to take him along just to see the country, and the trip is told as a link to the Sandia government laboratory in Albuquerque.
